laws.rule: replay reads only observations/evidence whose historically knowable timestamp is on or before knowledge_cutoff
revisions are append-only and linked to predecessor revisions; latest-value overwrite is prohibited
historical reconstruction requires explicit reconstruction mode, immutable source locator/hash, publication-or-availability proof, and revision lineage
historical reconstruction may reconstruct the information set but may not replace historical values with today’s revised latest values
feature records inherit the strictest known_as_of across all required inputs unless a more conservative explicit cutoff is used
agent and replay access must use PIT-safe RPC/function or equivalently enforced data access; unrestricted raw table access is not a compliant replay path
settlement may evaluate a frozen historical object but may not mutate its T0 evidence, forecast or thesis identity
if knowability cannot be established, replay eligibility is unknown/ineligible rather than inferred from current availability
